explanation: Its venom can cause people severe pain for weeks, though it is not deadly to humans. Males use their spurs mostly against rival males in the breeding season.

claims.text: Male platypuses have a venomous spur on the ankle of each hind leg.
Hedgehogs, porcupines and armadillos do not have venomous spurs.
Platypus venom can cause severe pain in humans lasting weeks, but it has not been known to kill a person.
Venom production in male platypuses rises in the breeding season, and the spurs are used mainly in fights between males.
